desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on unconfirmed reports of massive explosions in Kuwait, initially circulated by IRGC-affiliated channels and later tied to possible Shahed-136 drone strikes. A secondary thread covers Zelensky’s dismissal of Russian security demands and confirmation of Ukrainian strikes on Russian diesel infrastructure. No other major developments surfaced in the monitored accounts over the past 48 hours.

## MAIN THREADS
### Explosions reported in Kuwait
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116948200380567882) posted initial reports of “massive explosions in #Kuwait” citing numerous IRGC Telegram channels and Tasnim.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116948929057071521) followed with a map image and noted “No confirmations so far.”
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116951063823872021) shared a “Security Source in Kuwait” claim via Naya that Shahed-136 drones were used, with one shot down near the Iran-Iraq-Kuwait border triangle.

### Zelensky comments on Russia and energy
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2116946682822955298) reported Zelensky rejecting Russian security guarantees, confirming Ukrainian strikes on Russian diesel infrastructure, and noting Russia’s reduced global export share.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116949158514884638) reported military movement near a missile base in Larestan, Fars Province, Iran (unconfirmed).
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2116951063823872021) cited an Iraqi army force heading to detonate a Shahed warhead near the border triangle (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for independent confirmation or denial of the Kuwait explosions and any follow-on Iranian or Iraqi statements. Continued monitoring of IRGC Telegram channels for escalation claims is expected.
